tips.text: Bring Oxylus with the Botanist mod; it auto-collects plants within 50 meters.
Run a Resource Booster or a relay resource blessing to double plant pickups.
Check the Grineer Forest day and night clock first, collect every same-phase Earth plant in one pass, then do the Ceres, Mars, Lua, Venus and Mercury plants back to back.
Grab 12 Threshcone, 6 Dragonlily and 2 of each Jadeleaf in your first day and night pass so you never wait on the cycle twice.
Skip buying the Titania blueprint; Amaryn mails it free after the last run.
Accept the quest before you use any Apothic, or the Apothic is consumed without advancing it.
In a squad, let one player spend an Apothic at the altar; do not all burn one.
Skip the Synthesis Scanner for the plants; you pick them up by holding the button.
Expect two to four hours of wall time, mostly waiting on the day and night cycle.
